bio: Saveria Sacco was baptized on 31 March 1776 at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, in Calabria, a daughter of Bruno Sacco and Marianna Cicco. She married Alessio Moraca in 1792 and outlived him, dying as his widow at San Mango on 31 October 1841. She was John's 6th-great-grandmother.
